modules.title: 支付路线图怎样显示已测和未测的高风险分支
覆盖率数字之外要看什么

items.title: 覆盖说明触达范围，不说明结果可靠
items.text: 一条代码行或一个分支被执行过，只说明测试经过那里。若没有检查正确结果，或用例没有模拟真正风险，数字再高也不能证明支付行为正确。

items.title: 优先补未覆盖的高风险路径
items.text: 查看优惠券叠加、支付失败、权限不足等真实风险，而不只追全局百分比。用需求和流程画出已测、未测区域，比单独展示一个数字更能指导下一步。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 测试覆盖率不是测试通过率，也不是没有 Bug 的证明。它只表示测试触达的范围；质量还取决于断言、测试数据、环境和是否覆盖了真正重要的用户风险。

lessonPractice.title: 报告显示代码覆盖率 100%，但支付失败时页面仍显示“下单成功”。最合适的结论是？

options.label: 检查失败分支有没有断言页面状态，并补一条支付失败后的可观察结果
options.feedback: 对。测试可能走到了失败分支，却没有检查页面是否给出正确反馈。

options.label: 确认失败分支已经被执行，再增加它的运行次数来巩固 100% 覆盖率
options.feedback: 重复执行仍只证明代码被走到；没有有效断言时，错误的成功提示不会被发现。

options.label: 保留当前覆盖率，把这次错误作为单独的人工验收记录，不修改自动测试
options.feedback: 人工记录能保留现象，但这个稳定失败路径仍缺少会持续检查用户结果的自动用例。

en.title: A report says 100% code coverage, but the page still says “order succeeded” when payment fails. What is the best conclusion?

options.label: Check whether the failure branch asserts page state, then add an observable result for failed payment
options.feedback: Correct. A test may execute the failure branch without checking that the page gives the right feedback.

options.label: Confirm the failure branch runs, then run it more often to reinforce the 100% coverage number
options.feedback: Repeated execution still only proves the code was reached. Without a useful assertion, the wrong success message remains invisible.

options.label: Keep the current coverage and record this error as a separate manual check without changing automated tests
options.feedback: A manual record preserves the symptom, but this stable failure path still lacks an automated check of the user result.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请报告支付流程的覆盖情况，不只给百分比：列出成功、支付失败、优惠券叠加和权限不足哪些已测、哪些未测。优先补未覆盖的高风险分支，并验证每条的用户可见结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Report payment-flow coverage, not only a percentage: list whether success, payment failure, coupon combination, and insufficient permission are tested. Prioritize untested high-risk branches and verify each user-visible result.

learning.assumes: You know one feature can have success, failure, and boundary paths.
learning.outcome: You can turn one coverage number into a question about which high-risk paths are tested and which are not.

modules.title: How a payment map shows tested and untested risky branches
What to inspect beyond the coverage number

items.title: Coverage shows reach, not reliable outcome
items.text: A code line or branch executed only means a test passed through it. Without checking the right result or modeling a real risk, a high number cannot prove payment behavior is right.

items.title: Fill untested high-risk paths first
items.text: Inspect real risks such as coupon combinations, payment failure, and insufficient permission rather than pursuing one global percentage. A map of tested and untested requirements guides action better than a number alone.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Test coverage is neither test pass rate nor proof of no bugs. It only states reach; quality also depends on assertions, test data, environment, and whether important user risks are covered.

distinctions.label: Unit test
distinctions.text: {c:test-coverage} measures the scope that tests reach. A {c:unit-test} is an actual kind of test, and high coverage cannot prove that its assertions are correct.
